We’re in LibreOffice Writer with the paragraph cursor placed. To push the first three words left and the rest right via tabstops, we need to:

1. Switch the tab‐stop selector on the ruler to a right‐aligned tab (two clicks on the left‐margin tab icon).
2. Click on the ruler at the right margin to set that right‐aligned tab stop.

```python
import pyautogui, time

# 1) Toggle the ruler's tab-stop icon twice to select the right-aligned tab
for _ in range(2):
    pyautogui.click(x=275, y=265)  # left-margin tab icon
    time.sleep(0.2)

# 2) Click on the ruler at the right margin to set the right-aligned tab stop
pyautogui.click(x=1675, y=265)
```
